blocks.text: Mastering Outlook for legal assistants on Mac

Legal work demands absolute accuracy. When you use Outlook for Mac, every minute spent searching for a folder or checking a calendar invite is time away from billable tasks. You should treat your email client as a workspace rather than just a message viewer. Start by organizing your navigation pane. Use the sidebar to group client folders by matter number. This prevents file clutter and makes retrieval faster.

Keyboard shortcuts are the fastest way to work. Microsoft does not provide a simple in-app menu to change these, so you must use the system level approach. Go to System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > App Shortcuts. Click the plus button to add a new command for Outlook. You need to type the exact menu name from the Outlook menu bar to make it work.

items: ⌘ + N: Create a new email or calendar item.

blocks.text: Legal assistants often deal with hundreds of emails daily. Focused Inbox can sometimes hide important client messages. If you miss emails, turn it off. Go to View > Focused Inbox and toggle it off. This ensures every message appears in your main list. Use rules to move routine notifications to subfolders automatically. You can set this up via Tools > Rules in the top menu bar.

Lazur helps you when you cannot find a specific setting. If you are struggling to locate the archive button or need to change your signature settings, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where it is. It will draw a circle around the correct menu item. You do not need to hunt through submenus. This saves you from clicking through three or four layers of settings when you are in a rush.

Scheduling is a huge part of your role. When you receive an email that needs a meeting, drag it to the Calendar icon in the sidebar. This creates an event with the email body as the description. Always check your default calendar settings to ensure you are not adding events to a personal or non-work account. If you need to share your calendar with an attorney, go to the Calendar tab and right click your calendar to select Sharing Permissions.

If you accidentally close a window or lose a draft, do not panic. Use ⌘ + Z to undo. If you need to find an email from three months ago, use the search bar with filters like 'from:clientname' or 'has:attachments'. This is much faster than scrolling through your inbox.

blocks.text: Common mistakes legal assistants make in Outlook

items: Keeping the Legacy Outlook interface when it lacks modern search performance.
Forgetting to check the 'From' address before sending sensitive client documents.
Relying on memory instead of using the Flag feature for follow-up tasks.
Ignoring macOS updates that include critical security patches for Office apps.
Not using the search filter bar to narrow down results by date or sender.

blocks.text: Outlook for Mac requires macOS 14 or later to receive the latest security updates. If you are on an older OS, you might experience sync errors or connectivity issues like the -3253 error. Keep your system updated to ensure your connection to Exchange Online remains stable. If you find the app is slow, check your Activity Monitor to see if another process is hogging your memory. Outlook can be heavy when it indexes a large local database.

faq.question: How do I switch between New and Legacy Outlook?
faq.answer: Go to the Outlook menu in the top menu bar. You will see an option to toggle New Outlook on or off. Note that Legacy Outlook support is ending for Exchange Online.

faq.question: Can Lazur draft my emails for me?
faq.answer: Lazur can help you dictate text into your email body using the fn key. It does not write the email for you, but it makes the typing process much faster and more accurate.

faq.question: Why is my Outlook search not finding emails?
faq.answer: This often happens if the index is corrupted. You can try to re-index by going to System Settings > Spotlight > Privacy and adding your Outlook profile folder, then removing it. This forces the system to re-index your files.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with my practice management software?
faq.answer: Lazur works on your screen. If your software like Clio or MyCase has a web interface or desktop window, Lazur can point at buttons or help you navigate those windows just like it does in Outlook.
